worker: worker-4 cross-cutting persistence analysis for the recurring top-10 ranking
ranking_basis: durability, not profit: expectancy in R shrunk by its own sample size (n/(n+30)), penalised 0.25 x standard error, 0.01 x max drawdown in R and 0.01 x longest losing streak; clones collapsed on realised trades; a placebo cohort ranked in the same table
reason_none_live_eligible: Nothing survives the two tests the brief makes mandatory. (1) Placebos: across 89 ranking cells from all four workers, 69 have a placebo inside the top 10, 52 inside the top 3 and 35 are topped by one; the number of placebo rows inside top 10s is 236 against 282 expected if the ranking carried no information - a ratio of 0.84, i.e. chance. (2) Deflation: 2,859,518 strategy evaluations programme-wide give free_t = 5.45 and the largest t-statistic in any top 10 anywhere is 3.92; zero rows clear even their own cell's free_t of ~4.1-4.4. Out of sample, trading last period's top 10 returns +0.005R per trade over 32,219 trades against a no-edge permutation null of -0.010R.

persistence_summary.nested_windows: Nested agreement is the nesting, not persistence. With clones collapsed and summed over 13 cells, the 9-month top 10 shares 63 names with the 6-month top 10 against a permutation null of 69.5 - BELOW what shared bars alone produce. 6-month to 3-month: 21 observed against 23.6. 9-month to 3-month: 14 against 13.5. Population rank correlation 274d vs 180d is 0.741 observed against 0.795 under the null. Not one pair type shows an excess over the nesting baseline. Only 69 of 130 of the 9-month top-10 rows even clear the 20-trade floor in the 6-month window, 15 of 120 in the 3-month window and 0 of 60 in the 1-month window: the four tables rank different populations, they are not four views of one ranking.
persistence_summary.disjoint_thirds: Out of sample the top 10 holds a detectable but worthless amount. Across 59 disjoint pair-cells the slice-A top 10 shares 149 names with slice B against 124.0 expected by chance - a 20% excess, sign test z=+2.67, Stouffer +4.19; restricted to the 25 pair-cells where a top 10 is a genuine choice it is 63 against 44.4. In absolute terms that is two or three names of ten carrying over instead of 1.8. It buys nothing: only 25 of the slice-1 top-10 rows are positive in all three thirds against a null of 33.7 (z=-1.85, BELOW chance), the percentile-rank carryover is not significant (Stouffer +1.49 adjacent, -1.02 one period further out), and mean top-10 Jaccard across thirds is 0.152 in the 8 cells where a top 10 is a real choice - 85% of the list turns over every period, reproducing the earlier walk-forward's 0.150 at MES 60m.
persistence_summary.realised_if_traded: Roughly nothing, and what little there is is not rule-set skill. Pooled over 21 cells, four lookback lengths and 32,219 strictly out-of-sample trades with clones collapsed, the realised expectancy of trading last period's top 10 is +0.0048R per trade against a no-edge permutation null of -0.0100R: an excess of +0.0148R, about one and a half hundredths of one R. The best configuration is 60m ranked on six months and traded a month at a time: +0.0706R over 1,455 trades, of which the null already supplies +0.0459R and only 3 of 6 cells beat their own null. 240m is negative at every lookback, daily runs -0.007 to -0.016R, 15m/30m -0.031R. The top-ranked strategy changes in 281 of 385 folds.
persistence_summary.placebo_vs_real: No. Ranked together and then followed out of sample, the placebos do exactly as well as the real rule sets. Selecting on the trailing window and trading the next period, the 723 real selections earned -0.0002R over 6939 trades and the 542 placebo selections earned -0.0110R over 4863 trades - a gap of +0.0108R, well inside sampling error and with both arms at or below zero. In the disjoint thirds, 13 of 66 real rows in a slice-1 top 10 are positive in all three thirds (20%) against 8 of 33 placebo rows (24%). Whatever the ranking is measuring, a random entry bar has just as much of it.

independence_note: Every symbol is its own universe and nothing here transfers between them. MNQ/NQ/MES/ES are one index complex and their agreement is not independent evidence; MGC and MCL are the independent contracts. Every timeframe is ranked on its own; the 240m and 1440m cells often hold fewer than ten qualifiers, so their 'top 10' is the whole population.
